_about: GEN22 — камера инженера (24), путь WEB-C, 27.11: фото переда и зада строго по ортовидам модели (design/props-web/camera24/ortho.html#v=front и #v=back&labels=0, кадр 2048×1152, поля m=1.18). Класс вещи — компактная камера 2009 года (образец материалов — Sony DSC-W210 / W220: фото автора и Wikimedia Commons, bunker-media/references/real/R10_camera_views/); марок, надписей и особых примет нет. Надписи кнопок (MENU, DISP, W/T, значки) на фото не нужны: их резким слоем кладёт make_maps.py из рисунка модели. Объектив убран, шторки закрыты. Паспорт износа общий. Запуск: design/tools/kie/kie_batch.ps1 -JobFile <этот файл>. Карты: design/props-web/camera24/tools/make_maps.py.

jobs.label: T1_front
jobs.prompt: T1 (file label, not part of the image, never draw it). Turn the first image, a computer layout render, into a real photograph. Perfectly straight orthographic product photograph of the front of a generic silver compact digital camera from 2009, switched off, on a plain flat medium grey background, with exactly the same framing and proportions as the first image. Keep exactly the outline and the position, size and shape of every part from the first image: the flat front plate of brushed silver aluminium with fine horizontal brushing, the polished bevelled edge around it, the large polished chrome lens ring right of centre with the retracted lens barrel inside it and the closed dark lens cover blades in the middle, the narrow rectangular flash window near the top, the small round amber autofocus lamp at the right, the three tiny microphone holes above it, the shutter button and the small power button sticking up at the top edge. Do not add, move or remove any part. Materials as on the camera in the second image, but this camera has no branding at all. More than a year of daily work use by an engineer in an underground facility: many fine hairline scratches on the brushed plate, the edges and corners rubbed slightly brighter, dull finger smudges on the plate, a little fine grey dust around the lens ring, in the flash window recess and in the microphone holes. No dents, no cracks, no chips, no stickers, no strap. Lit with soft completely even shadowless light: no reflections, no highlights, no gradient. Natural colours, everything sharp. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand name and no logo anywhere: the front plate and the lens rings are completely blank metal.

jobs.label: T2_back
jobs.prompt: T2 (file label, not part of the image, never draw it). Turn the first image, a computer layout render, into a real photograph. Perfectly straight orthographic product photograph of the back of a generic silver compact digital camera from 2009, switched off, on a plain flat medium grey background, with exactly the same framing and proportions as the first image. Keep exactly the outline and the position, size and shape of every part from the first image: the large glossy black LCD screen window on the left, switched off and dark, with its thin black border; on the right the rectangular zoom rocker at the top, the small round mode dial with a knurled edge, the small round button left of the dial, the large round four-way control ring with the round button in its centre, the two small round buttons below it, the small dots of the thumb rest at the right edge; the shutter button and power button sticking up at the top edge. Do not add, move or remove any part. The back shell is satin silver painted metal like the camera in the second image, the buttons and the control ring are satin silver metal, slightly lighter than the shell. More than a year of daily work use by an engineer in an underground facility: fine hairline scratches on the screen window and on the shell, the paint rubbed slightly smoother and shinier where the thumb rests and around the control ring, faint greasy smears on the screen, a little fine grey dust in the gaps around the buttons, around the screen window and in the knurling of the dial. No dents, no cracks, no chips, no stickers, no strap. Lit with soft completely even shadowless light: no reflections, no highlights, no gradient. Natural colours, everything sharp. No text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no symbols, no brand name and no logo anywhere: every button, the ring, the dial and the shell around them are completely blank.
